featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with Discovery Events, led by Shailesh Gandhi and his son Yash, was deeply disappointing and fell far below the expected standard for professional wedding planning. We encountered a pattern of mismanagement, lack of accountability, and a noticeable absence of leadership.

The coordination between the father-son duo was minimal, leaving us uncertain about who would be present, which was the opposite of the clarity we sought. We were shocked by a complete lack of care or client hand-holding.

Absence and Lack of Onsite Management
- The Discovery team was not visibly present, forcing the family to handle essential wedding planner responsibilities, including vendor coordination, guest logistics, and timeline management.
- There was no senior, qualified individual overseeing the event; execution felt ad hoc, reactive, and poorly coordinated.
- The onsite team primarily consisted of very young staff (around 23–25 years old) with limited experience. Decisions requiring judgment were frequently escalated to the family or the bride and groom, instead of being handled by the planning team.
- The team was even escalating issues like vendor arrival delays and room readiness directly to the bride and groom.

Consistent Communication Failures
- RSVP team often went silent, leading to multiple guest complaints.
- The hospitality team failed to allocate a guest room, and we had to repeatedly correct the guest list ourselves.
- We had to chase the team for updates on stationery, vendor cabs, and timelines, with little to no proactive response or communication from Discovery.
- There was repeated pushback on our ideas (sound/lighting, rickshaw, cocktail décor, etc.), meaning the final execution often did not match the family's vision.

Major Issues During the Wedding
- Rooming information was not communicated on time, forcing the family to assign rooms directly with hotel staff on Day 0.
- Important hotel traditions and customs were never conveyed to us, causing avoidable confusion, despite Discovery’s claim of hosting many weddings at the property.
- Bridal mehndi was poorly scheduled in a dark, dingy room with no alternatives offered.
- The Sangeet entry was mishandled, and the sound check for an external vendor appeared poorly coordinated.
- Photographers were managed by the family, with the team repeatedly discussing timings with the bride and groom instead of a Discovery representative.
- Pooja materials, despite being communicated well in advance, did not arrive on time.

Transparency and Professionalism Concerns
- When elements were arranged independently (bangles, rickshaw, DJ truck, postcards), we noticed a visible decline in Discovery’s involvement and support.
- There was no transparency in the actual cost of elements, raising concerns about markups and unclear pricing.
- A team member's highly unprofessional comment about a deduction coming from their paycheck, following an instruction from Shailesh.

Overall, our experience with Discovery Events did not reflect the professionalism, reliability, or expertise expected of a wedding planning company. We hope the company addresses the significant gaps in their service standards.

We kept getting interrupted during our own events with basic questions that should have been handled by Yash or Shailesh. Meanwhile, the senior team was mostly absent, Shailesh was mostly in the room, showing up briefly like guests rather than actually running the wedding and Yash didn’t  care to even show up at the wedding

One of the most disappointing moments was around the fireworks—a key element we were really looking forward to as part of our celebration. Please go to anyone else but them.
